Discovery never enables model policies. Remote catalogue refresh occurs at exchange/refresh,not every prompt.

One-shot initial publication checks generation,value and whole encrypted-document revision. Any intervening document write requires a new login,including unrelated writes. Absent-key logout persists intent;conditional cancellation rollback never overwrites a newer writer.
Encrypted document version1 and owner-only storage remain;no tombstone schema or migration.
Private exact facade/delegate and actual model/API admit replay. Shared syntax,mutable labels and subclasses confer no grant.
Account-authoritative metadata fails closed on missing/stale local discovery;no subscription price or cache-warming guarantee.
remaining: Server OAuth start/device/exchange/publication integration and Web Settings login.
Interactive CLI login and actual subscription RPC/print journeys.
Complete owner-specific output/context/default/cache/usage/media and broader lifecycle qualification.
Genuine installed Copilot consumer,live account and dedicated production runtime qualification.
Earlier nine-root strict45-diagnostic hold,server-administration Core SIGSEGV,MiniMax canonical hold and all sealed predecessor failures remain unresolved.
Photon/before-persistence image preparation remains unapproved and unimplemented.
